sentences: The Cobalt terminal applies the parameters of every SessionUpdate message in the order received.
It never applies two parameters at the same time.
When all parameters have been applied, it sends a SessionUpdateComplete message.
When a parameter cannot be applied, it starts the recovery steps and does not send a SessionUpdateComplete message.
This behaviour was validated in the lab last year.

requirements.text: The terminal shall apply the parameters of every SessionUpdate message in the order received.
The terminal shall not apply two parameters at the same time.
When all parameters have been applied, the terminal shall send a SessionUpdateComplete message.
When a parameter cannot be applied, the terminal shall start the recovery steps.
When a parameter cannot be applied, the terminal shall not send a SessionUpdateComplete message.
